comment:
* Represents the area of the display that is not functional for displaying content. * *

{@code DisplayCutoutCompat} instances are immutable.

methods.name: private static DisplayCutout constructDisplayCutout(@NonNull Insets safeInsets, @Nullable Rect boundLeft, @Nullable Rect boundTop, @Nullable Rect boundRight, @Nullable Rect boundBottom, @NonNull Insets waterfallInsets, @Nullable Path cutoutPath)
public int getSafeInsetTop()
methods.comment: Returns the inset from the top which avoids the display cutout in pixels.

methods.name: public int getSafeInsetBottom()
methods.comment: Returns the inset from the bottom which avoids the display cutout in pixels.

methods.name: public int getSafeInsetLeft()
methods.comment: Returns the inset from the left which avoids the display cutout in pixels.

methods.name: public int getSafeInsetRight()
methods.comment: Returns the inset from the right which avoids the display cutout in pixels.

methods.name: public List<Rect> getBoundingRects()
methods.comment:
* Returns a list of {@code Rect}s, each of which is the bounding rectangle for a non-functional
     * area on the display.
     *
     * There will be at most one non-functional area per short edge of the device, and none on
     * the long edges.
     *
     * @return a list of bounding {@code Rect}s, one for each display cutout area.

methods.name: public Insets getWaterfallInsets()
methods.comment:
* Returns the insets representing the curved areas of a waterfall display.
     *
     * A waterfall display has curved areas along the edges of the screen. Apps should be careful
     * when showing UI and handling touch input in those insets because the curve may impair
     * legibility and can frequently lead to unintended touch inputs.
     *
     * @return the insets for the curved areas of a waterfall display in pixels or {@code
     * Insets.NONE} if there are no curved areas or they don't overlap with the window.

methods.name: public Path getCutoutPath()
methods.comment:
* Returns a Path that contains the cutout paths of all sides on the display.
     * To get a cutout path for one specific side, apps can intersect the Path with the Rect
     * obtained from getBoundingRectLeft(), getBoundingRectTop(), getBoundingRectRight() or
     * getBoundingRectBottom().
     *
     * @return the path corresponding to the cutout, or null if there is no cutout on the display.

methodNames: private static DisplayCutout constructDisplayCutout(@NonNull Insets safeInsets, @Nullable Rect boundLeft, @Nullable Rect boundTop, @Nullable Rect boundRight, @Nullable Rect boundBottom, @NonNull Insets waterfallInsets, @Nullable Path cutoutPath)
